meta_description:
298 likes, 6 comments - themomsco on November 15, 2022: "Happiness is… a playdate with your #children!💗💗

Last week, your favourite brand collaborated with you favourite luxury store @foodhallindia for an event. We had a cupcake customisation stall where the chef for foodhall created bespoke cupcakes for children! 🧁🧁😍😍

It was amazing seeing so many amazing moms and their children enjoying the playdate!💙💙

Tag your mom friend and share this cool playdate idea with her.👇🏻🥰🥰

#TheMomsCo #MomsCoBaby #Foodhall #FoodhallIndia  #MomAndBaby #MomAndChild #HappyChildrensDay".
